# Vamsa - Family Tree Application

A modern, privacy-focused family tree application built with Next.js.

## Features

- **Person Management**: Create and manage family members with detailed profiles
- **Relationship Tracking**: Define parent-child and spouse relationships
- **Family Units**: Group related individuals into family units
- **Visual Family Tree**: Interactive tree visualization
- **Photo Management**: Upload and manage photos for family members
- **Data Backup**: Export and import your family data
- **Local Storage**: All data stored locally for privacy

## Tech Stack

- **Framework**: Next.js 15 with App Router
- **Database**: SQLite with Prisma ORM
- **UI**: Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui components
- **Language**: TypeScript

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- Node.js 18+
- npm or yarn

### Installation

1. Clone the repository:
```bash
git clone <repository-url>
cd vamsa
```

2. Install dependencies:
```bash
npm install
```

3. Set up the database:
```bash
npx prisma generate
npx prisma db push
```

4. Start the development server:
```bash
npm run dev
```

5. Open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000) in your browser.

## Project Structure

```
src/
├── actions/     # Server actions for data operations
├── app/         # Next.js app router pages
├── components/  # React components
├── lib/         # Utility functions and configurations
└── types/       # TypeScript type definitions
```

## Development

- Run tests: `npm test`
- Run linter: `npm run lint`
- Format code: `npm run format`

## License

MIT

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

model Person {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  firstName String
  lastName  String?
  birthDate String? // ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) for date-only storage
  deathDate String? // ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) for date-only storage
  gender    String?
  notes     String?
  photoUrl  String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  // GEDCOM-related fields
  gedcomId  String? // Original GEDCOM XREF (e.g., @I1@)

  // Relationships
  parentRelationships  Relationship[] @relation("ChildRelationships")
  childRelationships   Relationship[] @relation("ParentRelationships")
  spouseOfFamilies     FamilySpouse[]
  childOfFamilies      FamilyChild[]
  images               Image[]
  sourceCitations      SourceCitation[]
  mediaLinks           PersonMedia[]
}

model Relationship {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  parentId  String
  childId   String
  type      String   @default("biological") // biological, adopted, step, foster
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  parent Person @relation("ParentRelationships", fields: [parentId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  child  Person @relation("ChildRelationships", fields: [childId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([parentId, childId])
}

model Family {
  id              String   @id @default(cuid())
  marriageDate    String? // ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) for date-only storage
  marriagePlace   String?
  divorceDate     String? // ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) for date-only storage
  notes           String?
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  // GEDCOM-related fields
  gedcomId        String? // Original GEDCOM XREF (e.g., @F1@)

  spouses  FamilySpouse[]
  children FamilyChild[]
  sourceCitations SourceCitation[]
}

model FamilySpouse {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  familyId  String
  personId  String
  role      String   @default("spouse") // spouse, husband, wife
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  family Family @relation(fields: [familyId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  person Person @relation(fields: [personId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([familyId, personId])
}

model FamilyChild {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  familyId  String
  personId  String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  family Family @relation(fields: [familyId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  person Person @relation(fields: [personId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([familyId, personId])
}

model Image {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  personId  String
  filename  String
  mimeType  String
  data      Bytes
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  person Person @relation(fields: [personId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
}

// GEDCOM Source model for tracking citations
model Source {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  gedcomId    String?  // Original GEDCOM XREF (e.g., @S1@)
  title       String?
  author      String?
  publisher   String?
  date        String?  // Publication date
  repository  String?  // Repository/archive name
  callNumber  String?  // Call number or reference
  text        String?  // Source text/transcription
  notes       String?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  citations   SourceCitation[]
}

// Citation linking sources to people/families
model SourceCitation {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  sourceId    String
  personId    String?
  familyId    String?
  page        String?  // Page/location within source
  quality     Int?     // Data quality (0-3 per GEDCOM)
  notes       String?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())

  source      Source   @relation(fields: [sourceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  person      Person?  @relation(fields: [personId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  family      Family?  @relation(fields: [familyId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
}

// GEDCOM Multimedia Object model
model MediaObject {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  gedcomId    String?  // Original GEDCOM XREF (e.g., @M1@)
  filePath    String?  // Original file path from GEDCOM
  format      String?  // File format (JPEG, PNG, etc.)
  title       String?
  notes       String?
  data        Bytes?   // Embedded file data (if imported)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  personLinks PersonMedia[]
}

// Link between Person and MediaObject
model PersonMedia {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  personId      String
  mediaObjectId String
  isPrimary     Boolean  @default(false)  // Primary photo for person
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())

  person        Person      @relation(fields: [personId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  mediaObject   MediaObject @relation(fields: [mediaObjectId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([personId, mediaObjectId])
}

## Vamsa - Family Tree Application

This is a **privacy-focused family tree application** built with modern web technologies.

### Tech Stack
- **Framework**: Next.js 15 with App Router
- **Database**: SQLite with Prisma ORM (local-first approach)
- **UI**: Tailwind CSS 4 + shadcn/ui + Radix UI components
- **Language**: TypeScript
- **Testing**: Bun test runner + Playwright for E2E
- **Tooling**: Biome for linting/formatting

### Core Features
- **Person Management**: Create/edit family members with profiles
- **Relationship Tracking**: Parent-child and spouse relationships
- **Family Units**: Group individuals into families
- **Visual Tree**: Interactive tree visualization with ReactFlow
- **Photo Management**: Image upload and storage
- **GEDCOM Support**: Import/export genealogy standard format
- **Backup System**: Data export/import capabilities

### Project Structure
```
src/
├── actions/     # Server actions (people, families, relationships, backup)
├── app/         # Next.js pages (people, families, tree, settings)
├── components/  # React UI components
├── lib/         # Utilities (GEDCOM parser, storage, backup)
└── types/       # TypeScript definitions
```

### Current Work (from git status)
Active development on GEDCOM Phase 2 features including:
- Source/citation support
- Media/multimedia object handling
- Character encoding (ANSEL support)
- GEDCOM 7.0 compatibility
